column1: # One line per commit, oldest first, tab separated:
#   unix time, commit, compile peak footprint, compile instructions,
# Compile is this commit's compiler checking this commit's json library.
# Run is the seven example programs, the only kanso spanning the whole
# history. Instructions retired and peak footprint come from the kernel,
# so a busy machine changes neither.
# Measured by scripts/backfill_history.kso, one build per commit. Checked
# in because recovering it costs an hour of builds.
